About This Film

GOAT is a Hollywood film on Feb 13, 2026. Directed by Tyree Dillihay.

Boxoffy tracks all India box office data using Box Office India (BOI) as primary source, cross-referenced with Sacnilk and Koimoi. All India Net figures are domestic only — overseas excluded. This page will be updated with actuals as they are confirmed.

Data Note

India Net = ticket revenue after GST deduction. Sacnilk and Koimoi report Gross (pre-GST), which runs 15–20% higher. All figures on this page are India Net unless stated. All in ₹ Crore (1 Cr = 10 million). Sources: BOI primary · Sacnilk · Koimoi · Venky Box Office.
